meta.name: nano-banana
meta.description: This skill should be used for Python scripting and Gemini image generation. Use when users ask to generate images, create AI art, edit images with AI, or run Python scripts with uv. Trigger phrases include "generate an image", "create a picture", "draw", "make an image of", "nano banana", or any image generation request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI生成或编辑图像，快速出图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成或编辑AI图像
copy.tagline_en: Generate or edit images with AI, quickly produce visuals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate or edit AI images

howto.what: 装上该技能后，Claude能根据你的文字描述生成图片，或对已有图片进行编辑（如添加元素）。它默认使用专业版Gemini模型，自动将图片保存到tmp/目录，并可同时输出文字说明。也支持执行其他Python脚本任务。
howto.when: 当你说出“生成图片”、“画图”、“nano banana”等关键词，或要求编辑图片、运行Python脚本时，该技能就会接管操作。

say.text: 请生成一张戴着墨镜的卡通香蕉。
say.note: Claude会运行脚本生成图片并保存。

say.text: 帮我给这张图片加上一顶派对帽子。
say.note: Claude会编辑图片并保存新版本。

say.text: 用nano banana生成一张16:9的风景画。
say.note: Claude会按指定比例生成图片。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can generate images from text or edit existing images (like adding objects). It uses the premium Gemini model by default, saves images to tmp/, and can output text explanations. It also runs other Python scripts.
howto.when_en: The skill triggers when you mention keywords like "generate an image", "draw", "nano banana", or ask to edit images or run Python scripts with uv.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a cartoon banana with sunglasses.
say_en.note: Claude will run a script to generate and save the image.

say_en.text: Add a party hat to this image.
say_en.note: Claude will edit the image and save the new version.

say_en.text: Use nano banana to create a 16:9 landscape.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an image with the specified ratio.
